audit.emptyDescription: Generate a key or sign a report to start the local audit trail.
audit.subtitle: A local, chronological record of key and report activity in this browser. Never embedded in a signed report or sent anywhere.
audit.title: Audit Trail

battery.empty: No battery passport evidence in this report.
battery.title: Battery Health

disclosure.exactTimestampsHint: Off by default — dates are truncated to the day.
disclosure.exactTimestampsWarning: Exact timestamps can make this report easier to correlate with other data sources. Consider day precision instead.
disclosure.hardExclusions: Always excluded, regardless of profile: {{list}}. These are never offered as a choice.
disclosure.sectionsCustomHint: Check every section this report should include.
disclosure.sectionsFixedHint: Fixed by the selected profile. Switch to Custom to edit individually.
disclosure.subtitle: Choose what this report includes. Nothing is shared until you export or copy it — this only changes what would be assembled.
disclosure.title: Disclosure Profile
disclosure.vinHint: Excluded by default. Even a masked VIN narrows down the vehicle.
disclosure.vinWarning: Disclosing the VIN (even masked) is identifying information. Only include it if the recipient specifically needs it.

evidence.scopeNote: This tab shows all evidence currently available for this vehicle, regardless of your disclosure selection. Use the Disclosure Profile tab to control what actually leaves your browser.

export.subtitle: Signing computes a SHA-256 digest of the report above and produces an ECDSA signature over it using your active local key.
export.title: Export Signed Report

import.badJson: This file is not valid JSON.
import.badShape: This file does not look like a signed vault report (missing report/digest/signature fields).
import.empty: No report imported yet in this session.
import.knownKey: Signed with a key known to this browser
import.knownRevoked: Signed with a locally-known, revoked key
import.subtitle: Load a signed report JSON file (from this browser or another one) to independently check its digest and signature.
import.title: Import & Verify a Report

incidents.empty: No security incident evidence in this report.
incidents.title: Security Incidents

intro.body: Nothing leaves your browser until you explicitly export it. The VIN, precise locations, coordinates, tokens, raw trip paths, and driver identity are never included unless you opt in (VIN) or are always excluded (everything else).
intro.title: Local-first, selectively disclosed

inventory.partialError: One or more evidence sources failed to load. Affected sections are shown as unavailable rather than guessed.
inventory.subtitle: What data is available for this vehicle, and whether the current disclosure profile would include it.
inventory.title: Evidence Inventory

keys.empty: No signing keys yet in this browser.
keys.none: none — generate one to sign reports
keys.title: Signature & Key Management

maintenance.empty: No maintenance or service evidence in this report.
maintenance.scopeNote: Maintenance data is read from an account-wide endpoint, not filtered per vehicle. If this account has more than one vehicle, some entries may not belong to this one.
maintenance.title: Maintenance & Service

page.subtitle: Build a selectively-disclosed, cryptographically signed vehicle-history report — entirely in this browser.
page.title: Warranty & Resale Vault

preview.empty: Build a report to see exactly what would be included, excluded, and warned about.
preview.noneExcluded: Every evidence section is included in this profile.
preview.title: Privacy Preview

software.empty: No software update evidence in this report.
software.title: Software Updates

usage.empty: No driving or charging history evidence in this report.
usage.scopeNote: Reflects an observed window of recent records, not a guaranteed complete lifetime history.
usage.title: Driving & Charging History

warranty.empty: No warranty evidence in this report.
warranty.scopeNote: Warranty details are scoped to the vehicle selected for this report.
warranty.title: Warranty
